subtitle: Cross-reference of 10 September 2026, confirmed reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT (17:20 UTC), with the presidential book at USD 147.09M. New prices were received by the winner contract, the second-place contract for the first round, the third-place contract and the Supreme Court impeachment contract. The national poll of the day is the PoderData/Aya, with 3,000 interviews and fieldwork from 06 to 09/Sep.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 43.50% (vol USD 10.46M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, down 9.00pp against the price confirmed on 09/Sep, and the loss of the lead. In the second-place contract for the first round he ROSE 4.90pp and stands at 24.50% (vol USD 578 thousand). POLL: 38% in the first round and 45% in the runoff in the PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep, fieldwork from 06 to 09/Sep, 3,000 interviews and a margin of 1.8pp.
fortes: He is still ahead in the first round of the national poll that came in today, 38% to 36%, and the PoderData/Aya has the narrowest margin of the window, 1.8 points.

In the second-place contract for the first round his price rose 4.90pp in 24 hours, to 24.50%, which describes a market that went back to seriously considering the possibility that he moves to the second stage.
Today's fall leaves him 9.00pp above the floor of his own series, 34.50% on 25/Apr, meaning the book has already priced him considerably lower in this cycle.
fracos: He lost the lead in the winner contract for the first time in this window, and the 9.00pp fall in a single day is his largest daily move in the series.
It is the seventh consecutive national result since 06/Sep in which he does not lead the runoff pairing.
The PoderData/Aya brings a new pairing in which Augusto Cury comes out ahead of him by 44% to 43%, the first runoff scenario in this series in which a third name leads.
candidates.analise: The 10th of September inverts the picture this page had been describing since the start of the cycle. The winner contract gave up 9.00pp and stands at 43.50% (vol USD 10.46M), while his opponent rose 6.60pp, and it is the first time in this window that the lead of the book changes hands. On the polling side the movement exists and is far smaller: the PoderData/Aya measures 38% to 36% in the first round, two points that fit inside two margins of 1.8, and 45% to 47% in the runoff. Both measurements point the same way today, and the difference in intensity is what deserves recording: the market moved 15.60pp in the gap within 24 hours and the poll measures a statistical tie. The context of the day is at the Supreme Court, with the Federal Police operation on the financing of the film Dark Horse and the second consecutive cancellation of a plenary session, and the page does not claim a link between those facts and the price.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 52.85% (vol USD 10.17M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, up 6.60pp against the price confirmed on 09/Sep, and the lead of the book. It is the highest point in his series, which opens on 14/Apr/2026 and holds 506 recorded readings. In the second-place contract for the first round he FELL 7.00pp and stands at 71.50% (vol USD 718 thousand). POLL: 36% in the first round and 47% in the runoff in the PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep.
fortes: He took the lead of the winner contract for the first time in this window, and the 52.85% surpasses his previous series top of 45.80%, recorded yesterday.
He comes out ahead in the runoff pairing for the seventh consecutive national reading since 06/Sep, even though today's gap, 47% to 45%, fits inside two margins of 1.8.
The 7.00pp fall in the second-place contract for the first round is consistent with the rise in the winner contract: the market now sees a greater chance that he finishes the first round in first.
fracos: In the first round of today's poll he is still behind, 36% to 38%, and that is the measure of declared voting intention.

The Federal Police operation on the financing of the film Dark Horse, authorised by Flávio Dino on 10/Sep, reaches the surroundings of his campaign, and he publicly described it as an attempt at political interference.
The price rose 6.60pp in one day, and a move of that size in a contract holding USD 10.17M is the part of the series most likely to correct in the following days.
candidates.analise: His contract made the largest daily move of the series today and reached the highest point AFOS has recorded, 52.85%, across 506 readings since 14/Apr. The second-place price fell 7.00pp on the same day, and the two things describe the same movement from two angles: whoever rises in the winner contract tends to fall in the second-place one. Today's poll runs the same way with far less intensity, with 36% in the first round, two points behind, and 47% in the runoff, two points ahead, both inside the margin of 1.8. The day was one of institutional crisis at the Supreme Court, with the operation on the financing of the film Dark Horse and the second consecutive cancellation of a plenary session, and the page records both facts without claiming that one explains the other.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.35% in the winner contract, reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading, and 49.25% (vol USD 150 thousand) in the third-place contract for the first round, confirmed reading, where he is the favourite. POLL: 10% in the first round in the PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep, his highest figure in the national polls of this window.
fortes: The 10% in the PoderData/Aya is his highest figure in the national polls of this window, against 6.6% in the Ideia/Canal Meio of 09/Sep.
The same round places him ahead of Lula in a runoff pairing, by 44% to 43%, the first runoff scenario in this series in which a third name comes out in front.
He is the favourite of the third-place contract for the first round, at 49.25%.
fracos: In the winner contract he is still at 0.35%, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading, meaning the money does not treat the candidacy as competitive for winning the election.
The one-point gap in the pairing against Lula sits inside the margin of 1.8, so it is a statistical tie rather than a lead.
The volume of the third-place contract is USD 150 thousand, which makes its price more sensitive to isolated orders than the main book.
candidates.analise: The PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep is his best reading in this window: 10% in the first round and a runoff pairing in which he comes out ahead of Lula by 44% to 43%. The one-point gap fits inside the margin of 1.8, so what the pollster measures is a tie. In the market the reading is another: 0.35% in the winner contract and 49.25% in the third-place contract for the first round, which describes a candidate the money sees as a third force rather than a contender for the office. The two things coexist without contradiction, because they measure different questions.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 2.15% (vol USD 13.15M accumulated) in the winner contract, the largest individual volume in the presidential book, and 42.50% in the third-place contract for the first round, confirmed reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT. POLL: 3% in the first round in the PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep.
fortes: His contract holds USD 13.15M accumulated, the largest individual volume in the presidential book, above the top two candidates.
He stands at 42.50% in the third-place contract for the first round, behind only Augusto Cury.
fracos: 3% in the first round of today's PoderData/Aya, against 11% measured by Palver on 09/Sep, and that eight-point distance between pollsters is the largest single dispersion of the window.
2.15% in the winner contract, meaning the price does not follow the volume traded.
candidates.analise: His case remains the one with the widest distance between volume and price: USD 13.15M accumulated, the largest in the book, with the price at 2.15%. In the polls the dispersion between houses stays wide, with 3% in today's PoderData/Aya against 11% in the Palver of 09/Sep, eight points apart in rounds with overlapping fieldwork. In the third-place contract for the first round he stands at 42.50%, behind Augusto Cury.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE: Ronaldo Caiado at 0.25% (vol USD 7.37M) in the winner contract and 5.00% in the third-place contract for the first round, reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT. POLL: Caiado with 2% in the first round in the PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep. Fernando Haddad and Romeu Zema do not appear in this round's prompted scenario.
candidates.subtitle: Back of the field in the reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT (17:20 UTC). ⚠️ THE PODERDATA/AYA OF 10/Sep MEASURES CAIADO AT 2% AND TESTS NEITHER ZEMA NOR HADDAD in the prompted scenario. All three remain below the 0.5% floor of the double reading in the winner contract, so the prices in this band enter as a simple reading.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), 0.25% (vol USD 7.37M) in the WINNER contract, reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, and below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the THIRD-PLACE contract for the first round he stands at 5.00%, on a USD 120 thousand book. In the PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep he has 2% in the first round.
caiado.fortes: ⭐ IN BOTH HOUSES OF THE WEEK HE HAS THE TIGHTEST [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) PAIRING AFTER THE ONE INVOLVING THE RUNNER-UP: 46% to 43% at BTG/Nexus of 08/Sep, the smallest margin among the three pairings in which that house hands the leader the win, and 41% to 38% at Quaest of 07/Sep. And he rose 0.50pp in the first-round third-place contract, back to 10.00%.
caiado.fracos: ⚠️ In the WINNER contract he remains below the 0.5% floor, and it is the only one of the three universes in which he does not move. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) the two houses measure him at 4% and 3%, with no meaningful change against their previous rounds.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% (vol USD 7.43M) in the WINNER contract, reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, and at the floor of the book. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for governor of São Paulo, and the PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep does not test him in a presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: He is not tested as a presidential candidate in the national polls of the window, and neither BTG/Nexus of 08/Sep nor Quaest of 07/Sep tests him, so there is no ballot-box reading to cross against the price.
haddad.fracos: The contract remains open under his name by inheritance of the market's design, not by a declared candidacy, and the panel keeps the line only so the residual price is not read as a signal.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.15% (vol USD 6.85M) in the WINNER contract, reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the THIRD-PLACE contract for the first round he stands at 0.75%, on a USD 50 thousand book. The PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep does not test him in the prompted scenario.
zema.fortes: BTG/Nexus of 08/Sep measures him at 2% in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) scenario that includes Pablo Marçal, against 1% in the scenario without him, and Quaest of 07/Sep measures him at 2%. The three readings fit inside each house's margin of 2 points.
zema.fracos: ⚠️ IN THE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) PAIRINGS HE IS THE MOST COMFORTABLE FOR THE LEADER IN BOTH HOUSES: 47% to 40% at BTG/Nexus and 44% to 33% at Quaest, that is 7 and 11 points of distance. And he stayed put at 0.85% in the first-round third-place contract, behind Pablo Marçal, who stands at 1.75%.

candidates.analise: Today's round brings little movement in this band. Caiado has 2% in the first round of the PoderData/Aya and 0.25% in the winner contract, with 5.00% in the third-place one. Haddad and Zema do not appear in this pollster's prompted scenario, and the panel keeps their previous figure rather than estimating.
fortes: Caiado keeps a presence in the prompted scenarios of the national polls, with 2% in today's PoderData/Aya and 4% in the Ideia/Canal Meio of 09/Sep.
fracos: All three remain below 1% in the winner contract, and today's PoderData/Aya brings no scenario with Haddad or with Zema.
The third-place contract for the first round gives 5.00% to Caiado, behind Augusto Cury and Renan Santos.

cruzamento: ⭐ THE LEAD IN THE WINNER CONTRACT CHANGED HANDS, AND IT IS THE FIRST TIME IN THIS WINDOW: Flávio Bolsonaro is at 52.85% (vol USD 10.17M) and Lula at 43.50% (vol USD 10.46M), against 46.25% and 52.50% in yesterday's confirmed reading. That is 6.60pp up for one and 9.00pp down for the other, and the 6.25pp gap that favoured Lula yesterday became 9.35pp the other way. 📈 The 52.85% is the highest point in Flávio Bolsonaro's series, which opens on 14/Apr/2026 and holds 506 recorded readings, above yesterday's 45.80%. 📊 THE SECOND-PLACE CONTRACT CONFIRMS THE SAME PICTURE FROM THE OPPOSITE SIDE: Flávio fell 7.00pp to 71.50% and Lula rose 4.90pp to 24.50%, meaning the money now sees it as more likely that Lula finishes the first round in second. 🗳️ TODAY'S POLL RUNS THE SAME WAY WITH FAR LESS INTENSITY: the PoderData/Aya measures 38% to 36% in the first round and 45% to 47% in the runoff, and a two-point gap fits inside two margins of 1.8, which makes it a statistical tie in both scenarios. It is the seventh consecutive national result since 06/Sep in which Lula does not lead the runoff pairing. ⚠️ THE TWO QUANTITIES DO NOT SUBTRACT: the price is the probability of winning the election, the poll is declared voting intention, and what can be said is that today they point the same way. 📌 The distance between them, however, is the finding: the market moved 15.60pp in the gap within 24 hours and the poll measures two points inside the margin.
